_comment: Allowlist for check-path-references.mjs. Each entry is a NORMALIZED API-path key (leading '/', no '/v1' prefix, params as '{}' or '{name}') that the detector should NOT flag. Only add paths that are intentionally-illustrative or belong to a DIFFERENT surface than the customer REST API — never a real removed/deprecated endpoint (those are findings to surface). Keep a 'reason' on every entry.

allow.reason: AEGIS's public Protection-Network SLO page at trust.mnemom.ai/slos, rendered in docs as a bare `/trust/slos` label. A published transparency surface, not an api.mnemom.ai/v1 REST operation (no such op exists in the spec).
Intentional old-path reference in old→new migration table in `concepts/cards-as-resources.mdx`. Canonical replacement: `/alignment/platform/default`. Not a live endpoint.
Same migration table row as `/admin/platform-card/alignment`. Not a live endpoint.
Same migration table in `concepts/cards-as-resources.mdx`. Canonical replacement: `/protection/platform/default`. Not a live endpoint.
Same migration table row as `/admin/platform-card/protection`. Not a live endpoint.
Changelog.mdx removal entry (amendment 2026-05-07): fast-path agent-scoped endpoint removed. Intentional removal documentation.
Changelog.mdx removal entry (amendment 2026-05-07): sovereign-setup preset endpoint removed. Intentional removal documentation.

`policy-management.mdx`, `concepts/policy-engine.mdx`, and `guides/upgrading-to-0-5.mdx` all explicitly state this endpoint was removed in the 2026-04-15 consolidation; policy is now part of the alignment card. Intentional removal documentation across multiple guides.

AIP protocol specification (`protocols/aip/specification.mdx` §10.4) references `POST /v1/aip/register` as the HTTP webhook registration endpoint. The committed spec only carries `/aip/webhooks*` ops. Intentional protocol-spec reference — docs are correct, spec is incomplete.

`guides/oauth-device-flow.mdx`. OAuth device flow exists in mnemom-api (MNE-1393) but is absent from committed `openapi.json`. Spec-incomplete, not doc drift. Pending mnemom-api follow-up to add device-flow ops to spec.
Same guide and reason as `/oauth/device_authorization` above.

`guides/upgrading-to-0-5.mdx` Note explicitly labels `PATCH /v1/agents/{id}/card` as the old path replaced by `PUT /v1/alignment/agent/{id}` in the 2026-04-15 unified-cards consolidation. Upgrade guide migration note, not active guidance.
`gateway/enforcement.mdx` and `quickstart/gateway.mdx` explicitly label `PUT /v1/agents/{id}/enforcement` as retired 2026-05-14. Migration-context reference documenting the retired endpoint.
Removed in 2026-04-15 unified-cards consolidation; no canonical replacement. `guides/safe-house-monitoring.mdx` and `guides/safe-house-threat-model.mdx` document the removal for migration context.

`guides/agent-claim-flow.mdx` documents `POST /v1/agents/{id}/move` (role-based agent relocation between orgs — the counterpart to re-claim). The endpoint is REAL in mnemom-api (src/index.ts route, openapi/tags/agents.ts:552, src/__tests__/agent-org-move.test.ts, `agent.org_moved` audit) but is absent from the committed customer `openapi.json` slice. Spec-incomplete, not doc drift — same class as `/oauth/device_authorization` and `/aip/register` (MNE-2374).

guides/customer-voice-privacy.mdx. Org Customer-Voice export endpoint documented ahead of implementation — NOT YET SHIPPED in mnemom-api. Product decision (2026-07-22): keep the docs, build the endpoints; tracked in MNE-2407. Remove this entry once the endpoint ships + lands in openapi.json.

guides/customer-voice-privacy.mdx + guides/customer-voice-retention.mdx. Org Customer-Voice bulk-delete endpoint documented ahead of implementation — NOT YET SHIPPED. Docs-intentionally-ahead per MNE-2407 (2026-07-22). Remove once shipped + in openapi.json.

guides/customer-voice-retention.mdx. Per-submission Customer-Voice deletion documented ahead of implementation — NOT YET SHIPPED. Docs-intentionally-ahead per MNE-2407 (2026-07-22). Remove once shipped + in openapi.json.

guides/customer-voice-retention.mdx. Customer-Voice retention-settings (GET/PATCH) documented ahead of implementation — NOT YET SHIPPED. Docs-intentionally-ahead per MNE-2407 (2026-07-22). Remove once shipped + in openapi.json.
